item.title: Sen. Fetterman Urges Dems to Stay Respectful During Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman urged fellow Democrats to remain respectful during President Trump’s upcoming State of the Union address, calling on them to avoid the “undignified” disruptions seen during past speeches.

item.title: Kevin Hassett Criticizes Democrats for Opposing Trump Despite Economic Gains
item.description: KEVIN HASSETT: When we’re out there defending the American worker and documenting great progress in creating jobs, lifting their incomes, and reducing murder, you would think that it would be celebrated by Democrats, but instead, they just have to oppose Trump no matter what.

item.title: Macron Praises Supreme Court Ruling Upholding Trump’s Tariffs
item.description: Emmanuel Macron praised the Supreme Court ruling on Donald Trump’s tariffs, saying it highlighted the importance of checks and balances in democracies.

item.title: California Avalanche Kills Nine Skiers; Rescue Crews Recover Bodies
item.description: Rescue Crews recovered the bodies of nine skiers who were killed in a California avalanche, authorities said Saturday.
